rules.D: At most one discretionary review per episode, at the very next Open; retain only if Open is protective to then-known stop. A second closing violation creates an unconditional next-Open exit commitment.
rules.entry_assumption: Next eligible regular Open; positive risk to stop known then; no actual entry or reentry inferred
rules.selection_contamination: Hypotheses informed by full original7-alert baseline; historical dry run is not independent out-of-sample validation
